text:
harper: Heads-up: security plans a KMS key rotation for keystore in eu-west-2 at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. They warned it may invalidate existing grants briefly and impact GPU node decrypt during onboarding.
audIT-bot: Change scheduled CHG-20250214-700 by @security: keystore-kms-rotate-euw2 at 2025-02-14T03:00Z.
dmitri: Which pools talk to keystore for disk decrypt and handshake? warmpool-euw2 (10.25.0.0/22) and spot-onboard-euw2 (10.25.4.0/24).
leah: If grants drop we'll see keystore:403 or kms:AccessDenied and nodes will fail to fetch DEKs -> join failures and node drains. Last similar rotation caused ~18% reduction in available capacity for ~20m.
harper: Proposed mitigations: 1) pre-rotate grant dance (create new key alias + pre-provision grants), 2) short-lived allowlist for privatelink if needed, 3) canary two nodes, 4) enable audit log tailing.
dmitri: I can run the grant dance, but need to coordinate with security. Also add a guard: block large onboarding waves during the 10m window after rotation.
leah: Monitoring: add alarm on `keystore_handshake_failures > 3% for 5m` and `gpu_onboard_success_rate < 95% for 10m`. Tie to PD.
ops-bot: Temp channel created: #temp/keystore-kms-rotate-euw2 (auto).
harper: Preflight checklist: - security to publish key alias + grants plan - dmitri to run canary at 02:30 UTC with `curl -H "X-Node: canary" https://keystore-proxy.internal/handshake` - leah to add alarms and cost guardrail to pause warmups.
dmitri: Will also add smoke script: `kubectl -n infra exec -it canary -- curl -sS -H "X-Node: canary" https://keystore-proxy.internal/handshake || echo FAIL`
harper: OK please be on standby 02:15-03:15 UTC. If canary shows any 403s we abort rotation and request targeted regrant.
